bibl.title: PGM VI: A Lost Part of PGM II.
bibl.seg: Eleni Chronopoulou, PGM VI: A Lost Part of PGM II.
bibl.note: This paleographical study aims to demonstrate that P.G.M. VI [P. Lond. I, 47 (= MP3 1867; LDAB 1798)] and P.G.M. II [P. Berol. Inv. 5026 (= LDAB 10637)] belong to the same roll and contain the same magical text.
